## Hypothesis
Changed length is enough to tell when a summary needs a refresh.

## Method
Take pages whose bodies were rewritten, judge by hand whether the stored summary still fit, and compare that with what the length rule would have said.

## Data
The rewritten-pages export, October to mid-November.

## Result
The length rule missed 7 rewrites that left a page about the same size. Not checked: pages edited only in a table.

## What it means
Length alone does not settle Q1; a signal tied to the cited sections is worth trying next.
